evidence.quote: (a)  submission of an STR in an Extensible Markup Language (XML) format3;
(b)  uploading a completed STR form in the prescribed PDF format3; or
(c)  completing the web-based STR form in STREAMS 2.
Hongkong Post e-Cert (electronic certificate) is required for this submission.

issues.explanation: The assembled sources resolve footnote 3: Hongkong Post e-Cert is mandatory for both XML submission and prescribed PDF upload. Both options need this condition; the generic submitter and unresolved antecedent in the e-Cert claim should become licensed firms using either option. No footnote 3 requirement is attached to the web form. Remove the corresponding missing-footnote dependency and stale uncertainties; do not extend e-Cert to all re-submissions irrespective of format.

evidence.quote: With effect from 2 February 2026, STREAMS 2 will become the only channel for filing STRs2.
For STRs submitted to the JFIU via channels other than STREAMS 2 following its implementation, licensed firms are required to re-submit the STRs via STREAMS 2.
(c)  upon the launch of STREAMS 2 at 9:00am on 2 February 2026, the operation of STREAMS will be discontinued.
(b)  for any STRs requiring urgent submission during the blackout period of STREAMS, please contact the JFIU directly by email (jfiu@police.gov.hk), phone at 2866 3366 or fax at 2529 4013;

issues.explanation: Footnote 2 is supplied and must be linked to the exclusive-channel claim. It requires re-submission for other-channel submissions following implementation without authorizing those channels. Its stated trigger does not cover pre-launch blackout submissions. Remove claims that the footnote, parent provision or separate obligation is missing, while retaining uncertainty about blackout follow-up. Migration of prior STREAMS reports remains distinct. The exception references to 'c12' also need replacement with the existing urgent-contact claim ID.

evidence.quote: 1 STREAMS 2 was introduced by the JFIU during the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Financing of Terrorism Webinar held on 17 and 18 November 2025. The presentation material is accessible on the SFC website

issues.explanation: Footnote 1 is present, contrary to the retained dependency and global uncertainty. Distinguish the supplied footnote from the externally referenced presentation, whose contents remain unavailable. Piece-local absence statements throughout the assembled inventory should be reconciled rather than retained as current coverage limitations.

unresolved_questions: What follow-up or re-submission treatment applies to urgent blackout submissions? The supplied post-implementation trigger does not settle this.
What requirements appear in the separately provided XML schema, prescribed PDF form and forthcoming re-submission guidance?
What sources do the opaque missing dependency IDs identify?
Does 'classified licensed firms' in the selected slice intend a narrower category? The source defines only 'licensed firms'.
What time zone governs the stated transition times? None is specified.
